title: Basic electricity
subject: Physics
description: Practice current, voltage, resistance and safe circuits.

questions.text: What is the unit of electric current?

english.short: Electric current is measured in amperes (A).
steps: Current tells us how much charge flows each second.
The SI unit is the ampere.

pidgin.short: Current dem dey measure am for ampere.
steps: Current tell us how charge dey flow.
Voltage is energy difference per charge.
A voltmeter is connected across the component.

pidgin.short: Voltmeter na the tool wey measure voltage.

questions.text: A 6 V battery is connected to a 3 ohm resistor. What current flows?

english.short: Ohm's law gives I = V/R = 6/3 = 2 A.
steps: Substitute 6 V and 3 ohm to get 2 A.

pidgin.short: Use I = V/R: 6 divide by 3 na 2 A.
steps: Put the numbers inside and divide.

questions.text: What does a switch do in a simple circuit?

english.short: A switch controls whether the circuit path is complete.
steps: Closed means the path is complete.

pidgin.short: Switch dey open or close the path for current.
steps: Open am and current no fit flow.

questions.text: If resistance increases while voltage stays constant, current will…

english.short: From I = V/R, increasing resistance makes current smaller.
steps: A larger denominator gives a smaller current.

pidgin.short: If resistance rise and voltage no change, current go reduce.

questions.text: In a series circuit, which quantity is the same through each component?

english.short: There is one path, so the same current passes every component.

pidgin.short: Series get one path, so the same current pass everywhere.

questions.text: In a parallel circuit, components have the same…

english.short: Each branch is connected across the same two points, so voltage is equal.
steps: The potential difference across each branch matches.

pidgin.short: For parallel, voltage for each branch dey equal.

questions.text: Which material is usually a good conductor?

english.short: Copper has mobile electrons, so it conducts well.
steps: Copper is used in many wires.

pidgin.short: Copper dey allow charge move well.

questions.text: What is the safest action before repairing a circuit?

english.short: Disconnecting power reduces the risk of electric shock.
steps: Switch off and isolate the source.
Never work on a live circuit.

pidgin.short: First off the power before you touch circuit.

questions.text: A 10 ohm resistor carries 0.2 A. What is its voltage?

pidgin.short: V na I times R: 0.2 times 10 be 2 V.
